description: JEWNEI crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C72 H34 Dy4 N36 O20 6-,6(C6 H16 N1 1+),C3 H7 N1 O1,2(C2 H3 N1),8(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Dy1 (Dy) has 3 O neighbors; Dy2 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy3 (Dy) has 8 O neighbors; Dy4 (Dy) has 3 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 2 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.612-3.619 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 96.53-103.98°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Et3NH]6[Dy4(ATNA)6(H2O)2]·DMF·2CH3CN·8H2O (C115H165Dy4N45O29). Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article compound name (structural notation)).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
